replaces.idea: A tabletop brass ticket-rail stand holding hanging numbered metal clips that release out-of-order work cards in strict sequence.
A floor-mounted railway switch stand with a throw lever and a two-aspect semaphore paddle.
A compact steel desk-side cabinet on short legs with three shallow, pull-out brass-handled drawers.
A heavy cast-iron mechanical arithmometer with stepped number wheels and a side hand crank.

new.name: In-Order Ticket Rail
new.depicts: A tabletop brass ticket-rail stand with a weighted base and four hanging numbered metal clips holding small punched cards in a row.
new.focal: One highlighted brass clip at the front end of the rail ready to be unhooked.

new.name: Switchman's Lever
new.depicts: A small floor-mounted railway switch stand with a cast-iron base, an upright throw lever, and a two-aspect semaphore paddle on top.
new.focal: The tilted semaphore paddle pointing toward the predicted track.

new.name: Quick-Draw Cubby
new.depicts: A compact steel desk-side cabinet on four short legs with three shallow, pull-out brass-handled drawers.
new.focal: The top drawer slightly pulled open with a glowing pale-blue card peeking out.

new.name: Brass Arithmometer
new.depicts: A heavy cast-iron mechanical calculator sitting on a flat base, featuring a stepped drum housing, a top row of number wheels, and a side crank.
new.focal: The gleaming brass hand crank on the right side.

new.name: Page-Flipper Index
new.depicts: A small desktop rotary card index on a two-legged wire stand with a side knob and fanned index cards.
new.focal: A single bright cyan index tab sticking up at the top of the wheel.

new.name: Pigeonhole Tag Rack
new.depicts: A compact wall-mounted brass key-and-tag rack with four small hooks holding stamped metal key fobs.
new.focal: A bright pale-blue tag hanging on the second hook.

new.name: Quartz Crystal Canister
new.depicts: A tiny silver-capped quartz crystal canister mounted upright on a two-pin ceramic base.
new.focal: A bright cyan glint on the beveled top of the crystal canister.

new.name: Outbox Card Tray
new.depicts: A small slanted metal wire-mesh desk tray on rubber feet, holding a neat stack of three punched cards.
new.focal: The top card protruding slightly from the front lip of the tray.

rework.redesign: Redraw as a multi-station factory assembly line on floor-mounted steel legs, with four distinct mechanical stamping stations linked by a conveyor belt.
